name: Tesla
sub: Consumer fleet plus in-house autonomy, the Waymo counter-model
about: EV maker and autonomy developer using their own vehicles as the platform for Tesla Robotaxi and FSD/Autopilot systems.
model: Vehicle sales, software subscriptions, ridehail/robotaxi service, energy products.
opMaturity: Commercial-limited in robotaxi; commercial-scaled in vehicles
deployment: Robotaxi service in Austin since 2025 and the San Francisco Bay Area, the Bay Area fleet supervised; a small unsupervised fleet operates in Texas, with Dallas, Houston, Tampa and Orlando added through 2026.
metrics: Austin geofence covers the entire metro (~245 sq mi) since 3 June 2026, but about 17 active unsupervised vehicles as of 21 July 2026; roughly 21 unsupervised across Texas against 42 authorised. Tampa and Orlando added 21 July 2026. Bay Area fleet larger (500+) but runs with safety drivers under California rules.
signal: Added Tampa and Orlando on 21 July 2026; scaling gated on the FSD v15 rewrite (~1B to ~10B parameters), targeted late 2026 or early 2027.

sources.title: Electrek: Tesla adds Robotaxi in Tampa and Orlando as Austin stalls at 17 cars
